## Description

Resamples training observations to reduce overlap among financial labels and improve the effective information content of model training.

## Where it may fit

Financial ML datasets with overlapping events and highly dependent labels.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, futures, FX and crypto ML pipelines; supporting method rather than a standalone trade signal.

## Required data

Event start/end times, label concurrency/uniqueness, training features and outcomes.

## Caveats

Sampling improves data handling but does not eliminate leakage or overfitting; apply only within the training fold.
